arguments.where_clause: CAST(strftime('%H', transactions.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 4
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction timed from 01:00 up to and including 04:59, whatever its type, amount, merchant or card.
assumptions: Times use the 24-hour clock in transactions.date, so 01:00 to 04:59:59 means hour 1, 2, 3 or 4.
No filter on transaction type, amount, merchant or card type is applied.
The data covers 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, so the rule applies to that period.
